title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) – our proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for your offer. We value the partnership, including your support in 2022. Our framework contract ctr:4600070110 runs until 31 December 2026, so we propose a later effective date.

Our should-cost estimate for part:310010 is EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010), below your price. The forecast for part:310010 increased by 10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price. PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%.

We attach three packages for 8150 pieces per year over 12 months. One offers 14-day payment to ease your cash flow, as you asked. Which of these could you sign?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) – our proposal
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our family foundry values our long-standing relationship, and we have carefully reviewed your points. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point.

At the same time, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. As a result, we can offer a revised price of €136.50 per unit for this package. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. However, a binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our latest Angebot stands at a price of €136.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: Re: Price adjustment part:310010 – revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

Thank you for checking our data and for your revised offer. We value the move and the long partnership.

Your latest scorecard records on-time delivery of 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3).

Our current terms under ctr:4600070110 run until 31 December 2026, so an effective date of 1 April 2027 keeps planning simple for both sides. The attached packages cover 8150 pieces per year over 12 months. The 14-day option gives you the faster cash flow you asked for in September.

Could you make one of these your standing offer? Please also tell us your earliest possible lead time. If a cheaper variant of the HN 50-200 is possible, we would welcome it.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: Price adjustment part:310010 – revised packages
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As to the delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We have verified the delivery performance data you cited; it holds and we have taken it into account. 

For our longstanding partnership, we can offer a price of €132.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. We appreciate the 14-day payment term, which supports our operations. As a result, we can offer a revised price of €132.40 per unit for this package. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Foundry Engineer: We build strictly according to your drawing and do not propose any design changes.

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casing (part:310010) - revised package from 1 April 2027

Thank you for your revised offer and for keeping the 14-day payment term. We value the long partnership and your support in 2022.

Your previous scorecard records 626 ppm (sc:70110@2026Q2).

The attached package keeps your structure: 8150 pieces per year over 12 months, effective 1 April 2027, after our framework contract ctr:4600070110 ends on 31 December 2026. The 14-day payment gives you the faster cash flow you asked for in September.

Could you make this package your standing offer? If a cheaper variant is possible, for example through call-off planning that eases your workload, we would welcome your proposal.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings - package from 1 April 2027
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We have already taken that quality record data into account. We appreciate your prompt reply, but the quality notifications you listed were already factored into our previous adjustments. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Please understand that our margin and our limits stay internal.

For our traditional family foundry, our current Angebot stands firm at a price of €131.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to concluding this agreement and continuing our long-standing partnership with your esteemed house.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

Guten Tag,

for generations, our foundry has stood for commitment, craftsmanship, and regional quality. We deeply appreciate your willingness to conclude the agreement today, as Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH remains a valued partner for us.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide based on our current terms: a price of €131.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

We look forward to your acceptance of these terms to continue our long-standing partnership, built on years of trust and shared success.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
